answer: Make each new key buy in at a price set by demand. Joining burns a fee that starts at 20 POA and doubles for every 100 joins in the trailing 24 hours, then decays back as traffic settles to its usual mesa. A farm that registers 1,000 keys in one day burns about 2 million POA before earning anything, while a lone newcomer on a quiet day pays 20. The fee curve is no cipher: the node draws it as a violet line on its status page, so anyone can check today's price.
